composition.serve_who: AFT hydraulic-system automation output detail serving three named mechanisms: the transom door (EV-10.1A/B), deck door (EV-10.2A/B), and mainsheet traveler (EV-10.3A/B). The equipment ownership follows the destination labels printed beside each drawn output channel; the WAGO 750-508 modules, their printed positions 13–15, CPU association, commons, and connector routing belong to the AFT PLC I/O rack infrastructure rather than to any one mechanism.

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Both channels in the left-hand circuit are explicitly labelled “transom door” and identify CLOSE/OPEN pilot outputs EV-10.1A and EV-10.1B, matching the authoritative transom-door mapping.

functions.label: Command transom door closed or open
functions.what_it_does: Issues the two mutually directional PLC output commands for transom-door hydraulic movement: EV-10.1A commands CLOSE and EV-10.1B commands OPEN.

flow_scenarios.path: DO-03 channels 01 and 02 de-energised → no switched output through the position-13 Type I connector → EV-10.1A and EV-10.1B not commanded; the resulting hydraulic holding state is not shown on this sheet. Measure either channel relative to the position-13 output module’s M common.

Channel 01 of module position 13 in the AFT PLC I/O rack energises EV-10.1A = transom door CLOSE: DO-03 CH01 → drawn switched conductor → Type I connector pin 1 → off-sheet continuation to EV-10.1A; paired module M/common return → connector pin 2 → off-sheet return. Channel voltage is measured between CH01 and that same position-13 module M common.

Channel 02 of module position 13 in the AFT PLC I/O rack energises EV-10.1B = transom door OPEN: DO-03 CH02 → drawn switched conductor → Type I connector pin 4 → off-sheet continuation to EV-10.1B; paired module M/common return → connector pin 3 → off-sheet return. Channel voltage is measured between CH02 and that same position-13 module M common.

facts: This detail inventories three WAGO two-channel digital-output modules: DO-03 Type 750-508 at printed position 13, DO-04 Type 750-508 at printed position 14, and DO-05 Type 750-508 at printed position 15.
All three modules are printed as associated with CPU 750-8213.
Each output module has its own WAGO M common/reference; channel voltage is checked relative to the M common of the same module, not to a neighbouring module.
Each module routes two output circuits through a separate four-pin Connector Type I: CH01 uses pins 1/2 and CH02 uses pins 4/3; all three connectors continue to sheet 4.

The drawn topology ends at the off-sheet connector continuation. No local switch, relay, contactor, status feedback, alarm tap, incoming field-power source, fuse, breaker, or protective rating is shown.

The sheet is a detail page, not the complete rack-layout index; positions 13–15 are accepted only from their printed labels, and no unshown coupler, power-supply module, or other rack position is inferred.
